Introduction

Ashatree is a South Korean girl duo consisting of Moon Jiwon and Bang Taeyeon. They released the collaborative single "Our Christmas fairytale" (with Monday Kiz, GyeongseoYeji, Gunho, Cha Gaeul and Lee Yeeun) on December 5, 2021, before officially debuting on May 14, 2022, with "Your Energy".
